clauses.quote: The Finance Committee will meet at least semi-annually.
meetings may be called at the Committee Chairperson's discretion based on need.
clauses.notes: Passive construction; permission rests with Chairperson.

clauses.quote: the committee will need to meet prior to and during the budget preparation period.
the committee should meet with the internal and external auditors.
the committee should review budget policies, indicators, other outcomes and procedures as well as the budget and auditing process.
The committee shall meet at least semi-annually.
It shall meet at the discretion of the Chairperson, prior to any sessions of the Legislature.

It shall review and evaluate all relevant sections of the Education Laws of Alabama and relevant Federal statutes and regulations and make recommendations for changes and modifications of those statutes to improve the delivery of educational services.

The Committee shall communicate and schedule meetings with appropriate entities at all levels of government and the community to have open dialogue about the concerns of the Birmingham City School system.
The adoption of rev;sion of any policy shall be done in accordance with Title 16-11-.18, Code of Alabama.
clauses.subject_text: The adoption of rev;sion of any policy

clauses.quote: Policies and policy revisions introduced and recommended to the Board shall be read at one meeting and adopted at a subsequent meeting.
clauses.subject_text: Policies and policy revisions introduced and recommended to the Board

clauses.quote: No policy, motion or resolution shall be declared adopted or revised without the concurrence of the majority of the who Board.

The superintendent will establish and maintain an orderly plan, which shall include the web site for preserving and making board adopted policies accessible, together with administrative rules and regulations needed for their implementation.
